title: Hohoo’s AI Lab
description: 公开学习、研究资讯与实践记录共用的个人知识站点。
descriptionEn: A personal knowledge site for public learning, research signals and practice.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.zh: 本站使用 Next.js，代码与内容同仓库管理。阅读路线、实践记录和外部资讯围绕三个研究方向组织；AI Radar 在独立工作流中采集、检查并提交内容，再由部署系统更新网站。
sections.en: This Next.js site keeps code and content in one repository. Learning, practice and external signals follow three research tracks. AI Radar collects, checks and commits content in a separate workflow before deployment updates the site.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.zh: 学习记录、未来选题和外部资讯容易混在一起，使真实内容难以发现。
sections.en: Published work, planned topics and external news can obscure each other.

sections.heading: Goal
sections.zh: 让读者快速找到真实内容、代码实现和下一步阅读入口。
sections.en: Help readers find real content, inspect code and choose their next reading step.

sections.heading: Architecture
sections.zh: RSS → 筛选与去重 → JSON → 构建检查 → 静态站点。Docs / Blog 元数据 → 内容索引 → 首页、专题与学习活动。
sections.en: RSS → filtering and deduplication → JSON → build checks → static site. Docs / Blog metadata → content index → home, topics and activity.

sections.heading: Decisions
sections.zh: 使用 Next.js App Router 与独立内容索引；采集在 CI 中执行，页面读取构建时整理的结果；个人阅读状态保存在浏览器中。
sections.en: Use Next.js App Router and independent content indexes. Collect in CI, read prepared content, and keep learning progress in the browser.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.zh: 来源可能失效或重复；关键词过滤可能漏检；聚合摘录需要保留来源边界。自动翻译目前暂停，缺少译文时保留原文。
sections.en: Feeds may fail or duplicate content; keyword filters may miss relevant signals. Source attribution remains essential. Automatic translation is paused.

sections.heading: Lessons
sections.zh: 当前实现体现的取舍：静态发布降低运行维护成本，但更新依赖构建；本地进度无需账号，但不能跨设备同步。
sections.en: Implementation trade-offs: static publishing reduces runtime maintenance but depends on builds; local progress requires no account but cannot sync across devices.

descriptionTw: 公開學習、研究資訊與實作紀錄共用的個人知識網站。

title: Java LLM 实践集
description: 从首次请求到多轮对话：三个可阅读、可运行的 Java 8 示例。
descriptionEn: Three runnable Java 8 examples, from a first request to multi-turn chat.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.zh: hohoo-ai-lab 是与学习文章配套的代码仓库，目前包含首次调用、响应解析与多轮对话三个 Demo。它是持续建设的练习集，不是已上线的 AI 产品。
sections.en: A companion code repository with three demos: first request, response parsing and multi-turn chat. This is a growing practice collection, not a deployed AI product.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.zh: 接口工具里拿到回答之后，还需要弄清 Java 如何发请求、读取字段和维护对话历史。
sections.en: After a successful API request, understand how Java sends messages, parses responses and manages history.

sections.heading: Decisions
sections.zh: 第一个 Demo 只用 JDK 标准库；后两个使用 Gson 处理 JSON。各目录独立，保留每个学习阶段，不急于引入框架。
sections.en: The first demo uses only the JDK; the next two use Gson. Separate directories preserve each learning stage without introducing a framework.

sections.heading: Validation
sections.zh: 作者已在 Java 8 环境完成三个 Demo 的真实调用，多轮版能根据历史回答正在学习 Java。代码侧另完成编译与离线自检。响应内容和 Token 仅是本次记录，不是 Benchmark。
sections.en: The author ran all three demos against the API in Java 8, including a history-based reply. Compilation and offline checks were also performed. These observations are not benchmarks.

sections.heading: Limitations
sections.zh: 历史只在内存中保存；没有流式输出、自动重试、持久化或上下文压缩。读取超时不等于服务端未处理。模型输出仍需核验。
sections.en: Memory-only history; no streaming, automatic retries, persistence or context compression. A timeout does not prove the server did not process a request. Outputs still need verification.
